metadata.title: AI Coding Agents Observability And Evals - Sources
metadata.description: Official documentation and implementation references for tracing, replay, regression evals, and cost controls in coding-agent runtimes

official_documentation.name: Anthropic: Building Effective Agents
official_documentation.relevance: High-level guidance on reliability, tool usage, and eval-driven agent improvement

official_documentation.name: OpenTelemetry Documentation
official_documentation.relevance: Reference model for trace, span, log, and metric correlation across runtimes

implementation_references.name: Claude Code GitHub Repository
implementation_references.relevance: Primary implementation reference for session events, task boundaries, and runtime telemetry opportunities

implementation_references.name: Codex CLI Repository
implementation_references.relevance: Cross-runtime comparison point for agent tracing, provider usage, and operational surfaces

implementation_references.name: OpenAI Codex State and Doctor Source
implementation_references.relevance: Pinned first-party source for rollout metadata extraction, SQLite state mirrors, goals/log databases, backfill metrics, and diagnostic telemetry shape

evaluation_references.name: Inspect AI Documentation
evaluation_references.relevance: Reference for structured eval runs, scoring, and regression workflows

evaluation_references.name: OpenAI Evals Design Guide
evaluation_references.relevance: Reference for practical eval construction, scorecards, and release gating

evaluation_references.name: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses (arXiv 2604.25850)
evaluation_references.relevance: Primary source for the harness self-evolution closed loop: component/experience/decision observability, falsifiable-contract edits, Terminal-Bench 2 and SWE-bench-verified transfer results

evaluation_references.name: Building Effective AI Coding Agents for the Terminal (arXiv 2603.05344)
evaluation_references.relevance: Independent terminal coding-agent reference architecture (workload-specialized model routing, dual-agent plan/execute, lazy tool discovery, adaptive compaction) used to corroborate runtime-decomposition completeness

evaluation_references.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions (moved to dedicated repo, mid-2026)
evaluation_references.relevance: Development-status OTel spec for gen_ai agent/tool spans: gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name/id/version, gen_ai.tool.name/tool.call.id, gen_ai.conversation.id. Requires OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental. As of mid-2026 the spec split out of open-telemetry/semantic-conventions into this dedicated repo; the old opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/* pages now show moved notices and the attribute registry marks gen_ai.* entries deprecated-in-place (relocated, names unchanged). Contrast with Codex proprietary otel crate.
